response: Yes, cytokine concentrations in pancreatic juice can predict the presence of pancreatic diseases. Research has shown that certain cytokines, such as interleukin-1 beta (IL-1β), interleukin-6 (IL-6), and tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-α), are elevated in the pancreatic juice of patients with pancreatic diseases, including pancreatic cancer, chronic pancreatitis, and acute pancreatitis. These cytokines can serve as biomarkers to help diagnose and monitor pancreatic diseases.
